incidents.title: False alarm: check error for StudyAtrium demo

updates.body: Automated checks for Studylife demo are failing. Web app: expected content missing from the response. Where it failed - Web app: the server answered, but not with the expected content.

tpl.message: Web app: expected content missing from the response

updates.body: Automated checks for StudyAtrium demo are passing again.
The demo was reachable the whole time. The content check still expected the old name StudyLife after the demo was renamed to StudyAtrium, so it reported a failure that did not exist.

tpl.note: The demo was reachable the whole time. The content check still expected the old name StudyLife after the demo was renamed to StudyAtrium, so it reported a failure that did not exist.
tpl.note_de: Die Demo war die ganze Zeit erreichbar. Die Inhaltsprüfung erwartete nach der Umbenennung der Demo in StudyAtrium noch den alten Namen StudyLife und meldete deshalb einen Fehler, den es nicht gab.
